in_marathi.name: Maruthu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maruthu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maruthu is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Marut', which refers to the god of wind. Maruthu is believed to be the charioteer of Indra, the god of rain and thunder.
